answer: I agree with the finding at [escalation.ts:64](/home/annas/Desktop/repo/agent-router/src/router/escalation.ts:64): `tierUp` can select a different provider even when `pinned` is true. The fallback helper respects the pin, but this higher-tier path searches all live candidates without checking it. If the pinned provider is unavailable at the higher tier, escalation can switch providers despite the pin. `tierUp` should be restricted to the pinned provider when `pinned` is true.
